name: PRFmodel
summary: Fits population receptive field (pRF) models to task fMRI with AFNI 3dNLfim (Conv_PRF model) using a stimulus aperture dataset, producing pRF parameter maps and polar magnitude and phase maps.
description: Demeans the BOLD series within an automask, builds an SPM canonical HRF reference with 3dDeconvolve, and fits AFNI's convolved pRF model voxel-wise with 3dNLfim (simplex search, 10000 random starts), then derives polar magnitude and phase from the x/y parameters. Use it for retinotopic mapping when a stimulus aperture movie matching the BOLD timing is available. The stimulus_diameter parameter is not read by main, and the README is empty.

inputs.description: Task BOLD fMRI time series (with optional events).
Stimulus aperture dataset used as the pRF stimulus (AFNI_MODEL_PRF_STIM_DSET).
inputs.requirements: Must have the same number of time points as the BOLD series.

outputs.description: pRF fit outputs: parameter bucket, fitted time series, and polar magnitude and phase maps.

parameters.description: Diameter of the circle within which apertures are shown
